packageRules.description: com.otilm:build-tools is not an external dependency: it ships from this very reactor, and build-tools.version must equal this POM's own <version>. maven-enforcer asserts that lockstep (the build-tools-version-lockstep rule in build-tools/pom.xml), so a Renovate PR bumping it to some released build-tools would fail the build rather than update anything. It is bumped by hand as part of a release.
